new_assertions.title: equal 20-cell bound does not determine cocycle integrability
new_assertions.body: The bounded 4x5 and 5x4 structural producers both have 20 occupied-cell ranks, yet the 4x5 full carrier has zero nonzero fundamental-cycle syndromes while the 5x4 full carrier has 25. The common 20-cell bound therefore does not determine cocycle integrability on these two exact cases.
new_assertions.scope: exact bounded 4x5-c4 and 5x4-c4 producer cases only

new_assertions.title: recursive quotient compression coexists with nonvacuous flatness
new_assertions.body: On the bounded 4x4 direct residual carrier, at least two distinct structural states share one recursive action-unlabelled class, while the full binary inheritance graph has cycle rank 1 and zero nonzero fundamental-cycle syndromes. Recursive quotient non-injectivity alone therefore does not force a cocycle obstruction.

new_assertions.title: exit-rich deeper continuation coexists with nonvacuous flatness
new_assertions.body: The bounded 4x4 deeper carrier has nonempty nonbinary-continuation, action-transporter, and branch/multiplicity-erasure exit classes, while its full binary inheritance graph has cycle rank 1 and zero nonzero fundamental-cycle syndromes. The mere presence of those exit classes is therefore insufficient by itself to force a cocycle obstruction.

new_assertions.title: full 5x4 obstruction is produced outcome-blind
new_assertions.body: The bounded structural phase producer consumes no solved W/D/L labels, yet its complete 5x4 carrier has 25 nonzero fundamental-cycle syndromes and 12 contradictory reconvergences. The full represented 5x4 nonintegrability is therefore present in the outcome-blind structural producer.

add_fixed: the complete bounded 5x4 carrier has 25 nonzero fundamental-cycle syndromes and 12 contradictory reconvergences, so the obstruction is not confined to the single shortest witness
the complete 5x4 nonintegrability census is produced without solved W/D/L labels as producer inputs
on the bounded 4x4 physical carrier, the exact W/D/L-defined optimal-edge restriction leaves the global partial2 sibling-delta set equal to the all-legal set: 176 vectors with rank 22
the complete 5x4 carrier contains 12 contradictory reconvergences; the shortest transporter/history route pair belongs to a larger exact obstruction family
the unchanged bounded 5x4 scalar carrier has 25 nonzero fundamental-cycle syndromes, not only the shortest local contradiction
the bounded 4x4 deeper carrier has nonempty nonbinary, transporter, and branch/multiplicity-erasure exits while its full binary cocycle has zero nonzero fundamental-cycle syndromes
remove_alternatives: the mere presence of any nonbinary, transporter, or branch/multiplicity-erasure exit is sufficient by itself to force a cocycle obstruction

rejected_candidates.body: Because 4x5 and 5x4 have the same 20-cell bound, transposing width and height causes the 5x4 obstruction.
rejected_candidates.reason: The two exact cases establish non-determination by cell bound, not a causal explanation by transposition.

rejected_candidates.body: Recursive quotient compression causes the 4x4 carrier to be flat.
rejected_candidates.reason: The packet establishes coexistence of quotient non-injectivity and flatness, not causation.

rejected_candidates.body: Nonbinary/transporter/erasure exits are irrelevant to cocycle obstruction in every case.
rejected_candidates.reason: The 4x4 control only shows that their presence alone is insufficient; it does not show they never contribute elsewhere.

rejected_candidates.body: Legal=optimal partial2 delta sets prove structural phase equals W/D/L or a nimber.
rejected_candidates.reason: The partial2 equality is an exact structural invariant under one W/D/L-defined filter; it supplies no theorem equating phase with game value.

rejected_candidates.body: Twenty-five nonzero syndromes require twenty-five Boolean correction coordinates.
rejected_candidates.reason: Syndrome count does not by itself establish a minimum corrected state dimension or codomain.
